title: Pietro contribution envelope (schemaVersion 1)
description: Downloaded by the browser, never sent. A curator reviews it and, if accepted, adds the candidateEntry (with updated review/maintenance fields) to docs/app/data. Authoritative validator: docs/app/lib/contribution.js validateContribution. No other top-level keys are allowed: access tokens, backend settings, browser metadata and chat histories are never part of a contribution.

candidateEntry.description: review.status is always 'pending-review'; effectiveness 'untested'; authority 'none'; provenance.sourceType 'contribution'.

narrative.description: Only present if the contributor explicitly chose to keep their free narrative.

sharingConfirmation.description: Records the contributor's intent to share for review. It is not an authorisation to publish.
